description: This file defines the FixedGridLayout class, a custom ViewGroup layout for arranging child views in a grid with fixed cell sizes, and includes methods to measure and layout child views accordingly.

classes.name: FixedGridLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that arranges its children in a grid with fixed cell sizes, supporting setCellWidth and setCellHeight methods to define cell dimensions.

methods.name: setCellWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of each cell in the grid and requests a layout pass.

methods.name: setCellHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of each cell in the grid and requests a layout pass.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the size requirements for this layout and its children based on specified cell sizes.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions the child views within the layout according to the grid logic, centering each within its cell.
